name: Tharnariun's Hope
summary: Tharnariun's Hope is a specialized trap crafted by the night elf Tharnariun Treetender in Darkshore. Designed to pacify diseased wildlife rather than harm it, the device projects a calming light intended to tame rabid thistle bears so they can be examined for a cure.

sections.title: A Gentle Snare
sections.body: As a mysterious affliction spreads through Darkshore, the local thistle bears have grown increasingly frenzied and violent. Rather than sanctioning a cull of the afflicted wildlife, the druid Tharnariun Treetender crafted this unique trap in the hope of studying and curing the illness. When laid upon the ground, Tharnariun's Hope emits a soothing radiance. Any rabid thistle bear that steps across the trap's light has its frenzy temporarily broken, rendering the beast docile enough to follow an adventurer back to Tharnariun's camp for treatment.

sections.title: The Elusive Remedy
sections.body: While the trap succeeds in subduing the maddened beasts without drawing blood, the underlying corruption proves far more vicious than anticipated. When Tharnariun channels his healing magic into the captured bear, the restorative power violently clashes with the virulent infection, causing the afflicted creature to collapse and perish. Despite the heartbreaking failure of his initial trial, Tharnariun insists his determination will not waver until the true nature of the forest's sickness is uncovered.

faq.answer: It is an enchanted ground trap designed to pacify a rabid thistle bear. Placing it on the forest floor creates a field of light that temporarily calms a bear crossing its threshold, allowing the beast to be led peacefully back to Tharnariun Treetender.

faq.q: Why does Tharnariun want a live bear captured?
faq.answer: Tharnariun believes that the sickness afflicting Darkshore's wildlife can be cured rather than ended through slaughter. He needs a living subject to test his cleansing remedies directly.

faq.q: Can you get another trap if you lose it?
faq.answer: Yes. Tharnariun assures travelers that his hope is eternal. If a trap is triggered in vain or lost in the wild, returning to him will provide another device to finish the task.

faq.q: What happens to the bear once it is brought back?
faq.answer: Upon the bear's arrival, Tharnariun casts a healing enchantment to purge the corruption. Tragically, the foul sickness is too entrenched; the magic overwhelms the beast, and it dies within moments.

angles.text: The trap embodies the Cenarion ideal of preservation over extermination, demonstrating a refusal to strike down corrupted beasts when a chance for redemption remains.
The degradation of Darkshore's beloved thistle bears strikes at the heart of the kaldorei bond with nature, making the device a poignant symbol of desperate compassion.
